extraction_rule.input: list-one.xml, every CcyNtry element that carries a Ccy child (entries without Ccy are territories with no currency)
extraction_rule.include: current country / territory (regional) currencies; X-prefixed regional currencies are included (XAF, XCD, XCG, XOF, XPF)
exclude: CtryNm starting with 'ZZ' (precious metals, bond market units, testing code, no-currency code)
codes named as fund codes in List Two
supranational units of account (XDR, XSU, XUA)
extraction_rule.historic_list_policy: presence in List Three alone does not remove a code that List One still lists as current
extraction_rule.code_list_hash: sha256 of adopted codes, ASCII ascending, LF separated, trailing LF, UTF-8 without BOM
extraction_rule.auxiliary_use: List Two is used only to justify exclusions and never to add a code; the text probe over the .doc is best effort, not a Word parser
